lessons.label: MA
lessons.parentNote: First blend: your child joins the sounds /m/ and /a/ into MA. Try stretching it out together: “mmm–aaa”.

lessons.label: I AM
lessons.parentNote: AM reverses the letters — it checks that your child reads left to right, not from memory.

lessons.label: DAD
lessons.parentNote: New letters U and D, first real word DAD (consonant–vowel–consonant). The word goes into the word bag.

lessons.label: MUM
lessons.parentNote: MUM: the same pattern with the new short vowel /u/.

lessons.label: MUD
lessons.parentNote: MUD practises hearing the middle vowel: MUD vs MAD.

lessons.label: MAD
lessons.parentNote: MAD — review: only one sound changes from MUD.

lessons.label: AT
lessons.parentNote: New letter T in AT, a word family starter (at, mat, cat…). Try rhyming at home.

lessons.label: MUM
lessons.parentNote: Listening round: the word is hidden, your child hears MUM and finds the letters by sound alone.

lessons.label: MAT
lessons.parentNote: MAT — builds on the “at” family from the start of this unit.

lessons.label: PIN
lessons.parentNote: New letters P, I, N (the SATPIN set) and the word PIN with the short vowel /i/.

lessons.label: MAN
lessons.parentNote: MAN: known letters in a new word — blending, not memorising.

lessons.label: TIN
lessons.parentNote: TIN: short /i/ again. At home, find things that start with /t/.

lessons.label: DAD
lessons.parentNote: Listening round DAD — sound-to-letter mapping without the picture.

lessons.label: NAP
lessons.parentNote: NAP: your child can now build many CVC words from the letters they know.

lessons.label: TAP
lessons.parentNote: Fill the gap T?P: your child works out the missing vowel from the word’s sound.

lessons.label: DOG
lessons.parentNote: New letters O and G, word DOG with the short vowel /o/. It unlocks Dog in the sentence builder.

lessons.label: PIG
lessons.parentNote: PIG: compare the vowels in PIG and DOG out loud.

lessons.label: POT
lessons.parentNote: Picture only, no text: your child recalls the word POT and spells it from memory.

lessons.label: MUD
lessons.parentNote: Listening round MUD — hearing /u/ between two consonants.

lessons.label: TOP
lessons.parentNote: Review: the game picks the word your child finds hardest so far, based on earlier mistakes.

lessons.label: CAT
lessons.parentNote: New letter C (hard /k/) in CAT. Cat now joins the sentence builder.

lessons.label: CUP
lessons.parentNote: CUP: hard C with short /u/.

lessons.label: NAP
lessons.parentNote: Listening round NAP — whole word from sound only.

lessons.label: COT
lessons.parentNote: Fill the gap C?T: the vowel is missing — COT, CAT and CUT sound different only there.

lessons.label: CAP
lessons.parentNote: Picture only: your child spells CAP from the picture — active recall, harder than copying.

lessons.label: SUN
lessons.parentNote: New letters S and E (completing SATPIN). SUN goes into the word bag.

lessons.label: PEN
lessons.parentNote: PEN: the short vowel /e/. Compare PEN, PIN and PAN out loud.

lessons.label: TEN
lessons.parentNote: Listening round TEN — hearing the new /e/ without seeing the word.

lessons.label: SIP
lessons.parentNote: SIP: S at the start of a word. At home, spot things that start with /s/.

lessons.label: TENT
lessons.parentNote: Fill the gap TE?T: the N hides inside the ending blend -NT.

lessons.label: SUN
lessons.parentNote: Review: the game picks the word your child finds hardest so far.

lessons.label: HAT
lessons.parentNote: New letters H and R. HAT goes into the word bag (“I want a hat”).

lessons.label: HEN
lessons.parentNote: HEN: a new animal for the sentence builder.

lessons.label: RAT
lessons.parentNote: RAT: /r/ at the start. HAT, RAT, CAT, MAT — a whole rhyme family now.

lessons.label: RED
lessons.parentNote: RED: short /e/ again, with the new R.

lessons.label: HUG
lessons.parentNote: Picture only: your child spells HUG from the picture — and deserves one.

lessons.label: HEN
lessons.parentNote: Listening round HEN — whole word by sound alone.

lessons.label: RAT
lessons.parentNote: Review: the weakest word learned so far.

lessons.label: BUS
lessons.parentNote: New letters B and F. BUS goes into the word bag (“I go on the bus”).

lessons.label: BUG
lessons.parentNote: BUG: B at the start and G at the end. The bug joins the sentence builder.

lessons.label: BAT
lessons.parentNote: BAT: B and D are easy to mix up — trace the letters in the air together.

lessons.label: FOG
lessons.parentNote: FOG: the new /f/ sound. At home, find things that start with /f/.

lessons.label: FIN
lessons.parentNote: Fill the gap F?N: FIN or FUN — only the vowel tells them apart.

lessons.label: BUG
lessons.parentNote: Listening round BUG.

lessons.label: BUS
lessons.parentNote: Review: the weakest word learned so far.

lessons.label: LEG
lessons.parentNote: New letters L and K. LEG: short /e/ with the new L.

lessons.label: LIP
lessons.parentNote: LIP: short /i/. Rhymes with TIP and SIP.

lessons.label: KID
lessons.parentNote: KID: K makes the same /k/ sound as C in CAT — two letters, one sound.

lessons.label: LOCK
lessons.parentNote: Picture only: LOCK ends in CK — two letters for one /k/ sound, a first taste of spelling patterns.

lessons.label: LEG
lessons.parentNote: Fill the gap L?G: LEG, LOG or LAG — listen for the vowel.

lessons.label: KID
lessons.parentNote: Review at the end of the first band: the weakest word of all learned so far.

lessons.label: S
lessons.parentNote: Letter hunt: the guide says the sound /s/ and your child taps the key — isolating one sound, no spelling yet.

lessons.label: T
lessons.parentNote: Letter hunt /t/. At home: say a sound and let your child point at something that starts with it.

lessons.label: SUN-SET
lessons.parentNote: Joining parts: SUN + SET fly in separately and your child swipes them as one word.

lessons.label: HOT-DOG
lessons.parentNote: Joining HOT + DOG — two known words make a new one.

lessons.label: CAT
lessons.parentNote: Rhyme: what rhymes with CAT? Phonological awareness — listening to the end of the word, not the start.

lessons.label: DOG
lessons.parentNote: Rhyme DOG – FOG. At home, make up more: log, jog, frog.

lessons.label: HEN
lessons.parentNote: Rhyme HEN – PEN: the -en family (ten, men, den).

lessons.label: SUN
lessons.parentNote: Review: the game picks the weakest word learned so far.

lessons.label: JET
lessons.parentNote: Band B “Words”: new letters J, V, W. JET: /j/ at the start.

lessons.label: VAN
lessons.parentNote: VAN: /v/ buzzes — put a hand on the throat to feel it.

lessons.label: WEB
lessons.parentNote: WEB: /w/ with rounded lips.

lessons.label: JOG
lessons.parentNote: Listening round JOG.

lessons.label: WET
lessons.parentNote: Fill the gap W?T: the vowel is missing.

lessons.label: JUG
lessons.parentNote: Picture only: JUG from memory.

lessons.label: VAN
lessons.parentNote: Review: the weakest word learned so far.

lessons.label: FROG
lessons.parentNote: Consonant blends: FR at the start — two sounds, said quickly. Frog joins the sentence builder.

lessons.label: CRAB
lessons.parentNote: CRAB: CR blend.

lessons.label: DRUM
lessons.parentNote: DRUM: DR blend. Goes into the word bag.

lessons.label: FLAG
lessons.parentNote: Fill the gap F?AG: the L in the blend is missing.

lessons.label: STAR
lessons.parentNote: Picture only: STAR — ST blend. Goes into the word bag.

lessons.label: SNAIL
lessons.parentNote: Listening round SNAIL: SN blend and the AI sound.

lessons.label: FROG
lessons.parentNote: Rhyme: what rhymes with FROG?

lessons.label: TRUCK
lessons.parentNote: Review: the weakest word learned so far.

lessons.label: SHIP
lessons.parentNote: Digraphs: SH is one sound made of two letters.

lessons.label: FISH
lessons.parentNote: FISH: SH at the end. Fish joins the sentence builder.

lessons.label: CHIP
lessons.parentNote: CHIP: CH — compare SHIP and CHIP out loud.

lessons.label: BATH
lessons.parentNote: BATH: TH, tongue between the teeth.

lessons.label: MOTH
lessons.parentNote: Picture only: MOTH from memory.

lessons.label: SHOP
lessons.parentNote: Listening round SHOP.

lessons.label: CHICK
lessons.parentNote: Fill the gap CHI?K: CK at the end, one /k/ sound. Chick joins the builder.

lessons.label: FISH
lessons.parentNote: Review: the weakest word learned so far.

lessons.label: CAKE
lessons.parentNote: Magic e: the silent E makes the A say its name. Cake goes into the bag.

lessons.label: BIKE
lessons.parentNote: BIKE: I says its name. Goes into the bag (“I go on my bike”).

lessons.label: NOSE
lessons.parentNote: NOSE: O says its name.

lessons.label: HOME
lessons.parentNote: HOME: now “home” unlocks in the sentence builder.

lessons.label: KITE
lessons.parentNote: Fill the gap KIT?: the magic E is missing.

lessons.label: BONE
lessons.parentNote: Listening round BONE.

lessons.label: CAKE
lessons.parentNote: Rhyme: what rhymes with CAKE?

lessons.label: BIKE
lessons.parentNote: Review at the end of band B: the weakest word of all.
